import.title: Import legs from a file
import.help: XLSX, XLS, ODS or CSV. The header may be in any of the first rows; the columns are found by name ({{columns}}, or “Departure ICAO” and “Destination ICAO”), departure and arrival are required. The order of the rows is the order of the tour, and every row that is not empty is a leg: notes, totals and drafts must be taken out of the sheet. A leg is the same leg when departure and arrival are the same. A cell may hold more than one callsign or flight number (ITY1357/1365, or separated by commas); aircraft are ICAO types, the groups of a leg stay as they are; the release is in UTC.

goals.Distance: The tour is complete when the great-circle distances of the accepted flights add up to the miles given.
goals.FlightCount: The tour is complete after the number of accepted flights given.

constraints.title: Filters and sequence rules
constraints.description: A flight that breaks a filter or a rule cannot be reported. The same route is never flown twice: that always holds, and needs no row.

delete.description: From the next report on, pilots no longer have to follow it.

hints.parameters.minNm: One of the two bounds is enough.

explain.DepartureOrArrivalIn: Every flight departs or arrives in one of the countries given.
explain.DepartureIn: Every flight departs from one of the countries given.
explain.ArrivalIn: Every flight arrives in one of the countries given.
explain.TouchesAirport: Every flight departs or arrives at one of the airports given: a "star" tour.
explain.DistanceBetween: The great-circle distance of every flight is between the minimum and the maximum.
explain.AircraftCategory: Every flight with an aircraft of one of the wake categories given. The types and groups admitted are in the tour's settings.
explain.ArrivalRunwayMax: Every flight lands on a runway no longer than the length given.
explain.ArrivalElevationMin: Every flight arrives at an airport at least as high as given.
explain.FlightRules: Every flight under the flight rules given.
explain.Chained: Every flight departs where the pilot's previous flight arrived: no teleporting.
explain.Eastbound: Every flight arrives further east than it departed.
explain.Westbound: Every flight arrives further west than it departed.
explain.IncreasingDistance: Every flight is longer than the one before.
explain.MinFlightsAt: On completion, at least the number of flights given have touched the airport. One per airport.

hints.code: As the regulation names it, for example GR4. Once among the general rules, once among a tour's.
hints.parameters: A number left empty is the check's starting value, or on an amendment the value of the rule it amends.
hints.errorIds: The errors a validator marks when the rule is broken. A rule with none is shown in the list.
hints.retired: A retired rule no longer holds on any tour, and is no longer copied.

rules.amendingHint: This tour holds this rule in place of the general one. Fill in only the numbers it changes: the others stay those of the general rule, even when it changes.
rules.effectiveDescription: What holds on this tour: the general rules, each replaced by the amendment of this tour where there is one, then the tour's own. A subtour holds its container's first.
rules.noneInForce: No rule holds on this tour yet.

copy.title: Copy the rules of another tour
copy.description: Adds the rules of that tour, with their parameters and errors. What this tour already has stays: a rule with the same code, or an amendment of the same general rule.
copy.skipped: Not copied, the tour already has them: {{codes}}.

explain.none: No automatic check: the validator judges this one alone.
explain.callsign: The callsign is one the tour allows. Also refused when the report is sent.
explain.aircraft: The aircraft type is one the tour allows. Also refused when the report is sent.
explain.flightRules: The flight rules of the plan are among those the rule admits.
explain.planAtTakeoff: A flight plan was filed before the take-off. The checks read that one: revisions filed afterwards are shown, and do not count.
explain.flightPlanForm: REG/ with an airline callsign, RMK with its slash, Z with COM/, NAV/ or DAT/, R with PBN/, a VFR plan without DCT and with VFR as its level, and SID and STAR in the route only where the airport's country asks for them (in the settings).
explain.landingAtArrival: The flight landed at the arrival airport, or declared a diversion.
explain.disconnections: The flight was not disconnected longer than allowed, once or in total.
explain.parking: The aircraft stood still at the gate before pushback and after arrival.
explain.speed250: No more than 250 kt below FL100, with the tolerance given. The indicated speed is estimated from the ground speed without wind; the 1,000 ft just below FL100 never fail. A FreeSpeed exemption softens it.
explain.simRate: The speed reported agrees with the speed between positions.
explain.maxAltitude: The highest altitude flown stays within the limit of the plan's flight rules: 19,500 ft for VFR and 66,000 for the rest to start with. Y and Z take the IFR limit.
explain.alternate: The flight plan names an alternate; ZZZZ only with ALTN/ in the remarks.
explain.equipment: The flight plan declares the letters of items 10a and 10b the rule requires for its flight rules. The letters of the level line — W and J1 to start with — are required only when the plan asks for a level above it.
explain.takeoffFromThreshold: The take-off roll started at the threshold. The tolerance is one for the division, in the settings.
explain.vmc: VMC at departure and arrival, on VFR flight plans only.
explain.repeatedRoute: A route already flown in a distance or open tour; A to B is not B to A. Also refused when the report is sent.
explain.semicircularLevels: Cruise levels by direction. Run on the validator's computer, with its navigation data.
explain.atcCoverage: The controllers online along the route. Run on the validator's computer, with its navigation data.

openIssues.empty: Nothing waits: no open issue on the legs, no dispute or clarification without an answer.

myTours.label: My tours
myTours.signIn: Sign in to see your tours.
myTours.none: You have not started a tour yet.
myTours.summary: {{legs}} legs accepted · {{hours}} h {{minutes}} min flown · {{tours}} tours completed

public.title: Tours
public.description: Fly the tours of the division: a route, a set of rules, and a validator who reads every report.
public.none: No tour is open right now.
public.errors: Errors a report can be given
public.signInToReport: Sign in to fly the tour and send reports
public.withdrawDescription: The leg is to fly again and the flight is free: you can report it again, on another tour too.

dispute.Open: Disputed: the next legs are open while it is looked at again
dispute.Upheld: Dispute upheld: back in the queue

public.disputableUntil: You can dispute it until {{date}} UTC
public.disputeDescription: Say what should be looked at again. While the dispute is open the next legs are not held; the answer comes in a thread you will find in your contacts.
public.disputed: Dispute sent. The answer will come in the thread.
public.issueDescription: An airport closed, a route that does not exist, a callsign that does not fit: the department that looks after the tour reads it.
public.issueSent: Thank you: the department has it.

fields.text: What should be looked at again

report.title: Send the report
report.nothingToFly: You have no leg to report on this tour right now.
report.notFlyable: This leg cannot be reported now. These can:
report.searching: Looking for your flights in the tracker…
report.noFlights: No flight of yours with a flight plan between these airports in the last {{days}} days that is not already in another report. A flight that just landed can take a few minutes to reach the tracker.
report.noFlightsOpen: No flight of yours with a flight plan in the last {{days}} days that is not already in another report. A flight that just landed can take a few minutes to reach the tracker.
report.noSecondFlight: No flight of yours from {{from}} to {{to}} in the tracker that is not already in another report.
report.diverted: The flight ended at another airport (diversion)
report.diversionFirst: Write the airport you diverted to, then choose the flight that took the aircraft from there to the destination.
report.proceduresRequired: This tour asks for the procedures flown: SID, STAR and approach on an IFR plan; the SID only on IFR then VFR; STAR and approach only on VFR then IFR.
report.sent: Report sent: it is in the queue for validation.
report.resent: Report sent again: it is back in the queue.

hints.sid: As you flew it, for example RAVA5A. Empty if you flew none.

atc.title: Controllers contacted
atc.chooseFlight: Choose the flight first: the controllers online along it are proposed here.
atc.searching: Looking for the controllers online along the flight…
atc.unavailable: The archive of ATC sessions is not available: write the controllers you contacted yourself.
atc.noneOnline: As far as the archive knows, nobody was online along the flight. Add the controllers you contacted, if any.
atc.proposedLead: Online along the flight when you were there: untick the ones you did not contact.

hints.exemptions: What a controller allowed that a rule of the tour forbids. The validator reads it next to the check it softens.

exemptions.kind.FreeSpeed: Speed restriction lifted (250 kt below FL100)
exemptions.kind.LevelChange: Level other than the semicircular rule

review.title: Validation
review.description: The reports of the tours waiting for a validator, and the ones decided.
review.ownNotice: This is your own report: you can read it, but another validator decides it.
review.heldBy: in the hands of {{name}} until {{until}} UTC
review.taken: The report is yours: nobody else can take it while you decide.
review.reopenDescription: The report goes back in review in your hands. The pilot gets a new email when you decide again.
review.reopened: Decision reopened: the report is in your hands.
review.decided: Decision saved: the pilot will receive an email.
review.noTrack: The track of this flight is not available: it was not stored, or it has been deleted after the retention period.
review.atcUnavailable: The archive of ATC sessions was not available when the report was sent: the controllers are as the pilot declared them.
review.profile: In this tour: {{reported}} reported, {{accepted}} accepted, {{rejected}} rejected.
review.noBans: No ban, now or in the past.

checks.pending: The automatic checks have not run on this report yet: they run within ten minutes.
checks.none: The rules of this report name no automatic check.
checks.ranAt: Checked on {{at}} UTC. Nothing here decides: a failed check suggests its errors, and only what you tick counts.

review.noErrors: The rules of this report have no errors to mark.
review.suggestionAccept: No error marked makes it a rejection.

reasons.dangerous: {{error}} is dangerous: a rejection from the first time.
reasons.overYearlyMax: {{error}} would be the {{count}}th this year, over the {{max}} allowed.

hints.noteToPilot: The pilot reads it in the email and on their report. Required for «to modify».
hints.overrideReason: Required when the outcome goes against the suggestion.
hints.reason: It stays in the history of the report.
hints.answer: It goes into the thread as the department's answer: the pilot reads it there and by email, without your name.

review.disputes: Disputes in this tour: {{open}} open, {{upheld}} upheld, {{dismissed}} turned down.
review.disputeDecided: Dispute decided. The answer is in the thread, and the pilot has it by email.

weather.none: No METAR or TAF was kept for the airports of this flight: the weather is not available.
weather.airportNone: No bulletin was kept for this airport during the flight.
weather.diversion: Diversion for weather: these are the METARs and TAFs of {{icao}}, the planned destination.

events.withdrawnAutomatically: Withdrawn: not corrected within the report window
events.disputeUpheld: Dispute upheld: back in the queue

pirepAccepted.title: My accepted reports
pirepAccepted.description: An email when one of your tour reports is accepted.

pirepToModify.title: My reports to modify
pirepToModify.description: An email when one of your tour reports is sent back to be corrected.

pirepRejected.title: My rejected reports
pirepRejected.description: An email when one of your tour reports is rejected, with the rules broken.

reviewDigest.title: Digest of the reports to validate
reviewDigest.description: One email a day with the reports waiting on the tours you may validate. None when the queue is empty.

legIssueReported.title: Issues reported on the legs
legIssueReported.description: An email to the department's mailbox when a pilot reports a problem on a leg.

banned.title: Bans from the tours
banned.description: An email when you are banned from a tour or from all of them, with the reason and how long.

ask.title: Ask for a clarification
ask.description: Ask the department to explain a decision, a leg or a rule. It changes nothing and is not a dispute; the answer comes in a thread in your contacts.
ask.subject: Clarification: {{tour}}

hints.references: Tick one or more: whoever answers sees each of them.

issues.title: Issues on the legs
issues.description: The problems the pilots report on the legs of the tours. Close one when it is dealt with.

hints.staffNote: What was done, for the rest of the staff. The pilot does not read it.

validators.title: Validators
validators.description: What every validator decided in a year, on which tours they are enabled, and who to add.

hints.vid: A member of the staff of the division.
hints.tourId: Nothing chosen: every tour. A tour covers its subtours, those added later too.

validators.none: Nobody is enabled and nobody decided a report this year.
validators.noTours: No report was decided this year.
validators.removeDescription: They keep what they decided; from their next sign in they no longer take reports there.
validators.addedDescription: They take reports from their next sign in.

pilots.title: Pilots
pilots.description: The record of a pilot in the tours: errors, flights, disputes, bans. Write their VID.
pilots.noErrors: No error confirmed on an accepted or rejected report.

bans.title: Bans
bans.description: Who may not send reports, on which tours and until when. A ban is never deleted: move its end to lift it.

hints.tourId: Nothing chosen: every tour. A tour covers its subtours.
hints.endsAt: Empty: for good. To lift a ban early, move its end.
hints.reason: The pilot reads it in the mail.
